source_authority.behavior: load_ntdll explicitly dlopens the installed architecture ntdll.so with RTLD_NOW before resolving and calling __wine_main

classification.stage_internal: dependency resolves from the staged Wine tree either through an explicitly proven preloaded Wine bootstrap shortname or at the first modeled musl loader search directory with matching ELF class/machine/endianness
classification.rootfs_external: dependency resolves from the locked Alpine rootfs at the first modeled musl loader search directory with matching ELF class/machine/endianness
classification.loader_bootstrap_shortname: only shortnames declared by the locked Wine bootstrap contract may be treated as already loaded; the exact staged path, rooted canonical target and ELF identity are revalidated before reuse
classification.loader_dynamic_path: DT_RUNPATH when present, otherwise DT_RPATH, with only rooted absolute paths or $ORIGIN expansion accepted
classification.loader_system_path: locked /etc/ld-musl-$ARCH.path when present, otherwise musl built-in /lib:/usr/local/lib:/usr/lib fallback
classification.loader_first_pathname_hit: after any explicitly proven preloaded-shortname reuse, the first existing SONAME pathname in modeled search order must itself be a compatible ELF; non-ELF or incompatible objects fail instead of being skipped
classification.loader_first_pathname_hit_evidence: a content-addressed JSON proof bound to the same runtime id and staged manifest must accompany dependency discovery
classification.loader_needed_by_chain: musl searches rpath/runpath through the needed_by chain before its system path; this discovery must prove the staged direct dependency target is invariant to any modeled staged ancestor path or fail closed
classification.loader_shortname_reuse: musl may reuse an already loaded shortname before path search; this discovery proves declared Wine bootstrap shortnames and one reachable logical target per SONAME and ELF identity within staged direct-dependency scope or fails closed
classification.authoritative_evidence: a final content-addressed proof binds the full-build proof, first-hit proof, loader-invariance proof and direct dependency inventory before loader_resolution_verified may be treated as authoritative
classification.ambient_ld_library_path: forbidden for deterministic discovery and future runtime assembly
